teaser: You're folding someone else's donated coat into a laundromat bag before it occurs to you that it isn't yours to give away yet. That's the shape of life path 9 wearing an INFP's four letters: compassion that moves before ownership gets settled. The 9 asks a life to let go of something personal for the sake of something larger; the INFP arrives already loyal to an inner sense of right rather than to habit or applause. Crossed, the two don't just agree on generosity — they agree on which generosity counts, and which release costs something real.
